messages:
sophia: Rivermark asked for a quick perf validation before moving to terms. Target: sustain 1.5k req/s for short gen calls (avg output ~200 tokens), p95 target <=450ms. They want a Dedicated baseline and any security blockers up-front. Call scheduled Tue AM.
lars: Confirm prompt sizes and chat vs single-turn? Hosted vs Dedicated preference?
sophia: Single-turn prompts ~120-180 tokens. They prefer Hosted for simplicity but explicitly requested a Dedicated cost comparison.
lara (typo corrected by lars): I'll run the bench tomorrow. Proposed plan:
- Warm 8m to 400 rps
- Steps: 400 -> 800 -> 1.2k -> 1.5k -> 2k (5 min per step)
- Sustain 20m at 1.5k, short 5m spike to 2k
- Variants: models=[13B-q4, 34B-q4], batch=[8,12], kv_cache=[on,off]
- Add headers: X-Req-Id, X-Prompt-Tokens, X-Resp-Tokens for tracing
bench-bot: queued job perf-rivermark-6198 on cluster=perf-bench-west, workers=56, eta=90s
nina: Quick smoke (13B-q4, batch=12, kv_cache off): p50=170ms p95=660ms p99=980ms errs=1.4% (timeouts around 1.5k->2k). Saw ingress queueing at worker side.
omar: Try batch=8 and 34B-q4. Batch tradeoffs likely matter more than caching here (hit rate low for their prompts).
nina: Rerun (13B-q4, batch=8): p50=220ms p95=450ms p99=760ms errs=0.3%. Sustained 20m at 1.5k stable. Short spike to 2k produced transient 503s but recovered.
nina: 34B-q4 batch=8: p50=200ms p95=410ms p99=700ms errs=0.4%. Memory pressure higher per host so fewer GPUs/host available.
omar: KV cache hit rate ~9% on Rivermark corpus, not enough to prioritize. If they had high repetition it would help.
lars: Cost sketch (very preliminary):
- Hosted: steady 1.5k rps, avg 200 tok -> approx $42k/mo (infra + platform margin). Bursting adds variation but ~+10-20% depending on duty cycle.
- Dedicated: reserved fleet (approx 8 A100-eq) amortized infra ~$26k/mo + platform fee -> customer quote ~$32k-$35k/mo with 99.9% SLA. Dedicated gives better tail and predictable pricing.
security-bot: Rivermark asks: customer-managed KMS (CMEK), SOC2 report, VPC peering for Dedicated. We support AWS/GCP KMS and provide SOC2 PDF. Dedicated supports VPC peering; hosted can use private endpoints and allowlists. Need to schedule a short key-rotation test window. SOC2 link: https://docs.redwood.ai/security/soc2.pdf
sophia: Sales items for the deck: 1) one-slide summary (numbers + p95/p99 charts) 2) cost ranges hosted vs dedicated 3) security checklist + next steps.
omar: I'll upload grafana snapshots and logs to perf/6198765430/ and include a short run-notes file with batch/kv settings.
nina: k6 curl examples for smoke (paste into deck):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model":"13B-q4","input":"<prompt>","max_tokens":200,"batch_size":8}'
```
and a tiny k6 pseudo snippet for load: `http.post(url, JSON.stringify({model:'13B-q4', input:'...', max_tokens:200}), {headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${__ENV.KEY}`}})`
lars: Action items: omar upload artifacts by Mon EOD, nina prepare one-slide perf summary by Mon noon, security-bot confirm KMS checklist + SOC2 by Mon EOD, sophia to send invite for Tue.
sophia: Thanks team. We'll show the Dedicated baseline and the hosted estimate during the call. :thumbsup:
